body: A Boogie took over the Rolling Loud College Tour ahead of the movie The Rolling Loud College Tour is bringing the hype ahead of the Rolling Loud movie, with A Boogie joining the tour. The film stars Owen Wilson, Travis Scott, Matt Rife, and more, and hits theaters October 2nd. : :.
